title: ニュージーランドTにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the New Zealand Trophy is finally upon us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This crucial contest will tell us whether or not Yamanin Zephyr will be able to hold her own in future mile races.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The New Zealand Trophy… A graded mile…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The real path to following in the Mile Emperor's footsteps begins here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is my path to becoming the true wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: When I think of myself moving closer to that wind, it feels as though warm puffs of air are tickling my face.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let us have the plum breeze blow, and open ourselves a new path forward.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Off I go.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: All right! One by one, the runners are entering the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Oh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Give it your best shot! I'm here to see you win today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You're gonna win for sure! I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (…What's all this?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (How peculiar… My ears are tingling.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Is it a dry pampero? The devil's breath? No… it's not exactly an unpleasant feeling.)

text_block_list.name: Runner
text_block_list.text: Hey… you're Yamanin Zephyr, right?

text_block_list.name: Runner
text_block_list.text: Good luck today. But remember—first place is gonna be mine!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm… Right. Let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I also have every intention of winning.
